title: VIXEN build presets require a manual source-directory change
body: The documented WSL witness invoked cmake --preset vixen-wsl from the repository root and failed with a missing CMakePresets.json; the working route required manually cd'ing into VIXEN before configuring. The build tooling should resolve the preset source root or report the located preset path and required directory.

title: Native VIXEN full builds need a resumable long-job witness route
body: The queued native Release baseline was terminated by the harness after 903 of 1393 build edges with exit 143 and no compiler failure; a second queued invocation had to reconfigure and resume from the warmed native tree before succeeding. The native witness tooling should expose a supported resumable/background route or preserve the build process across the harness watchdog.

title: Native look-dev matrix capture requires a missing four-angle helper
body: The documented run-capture.bat accepts one state and angle and refuses reuse of one NAME, so a naive matrix loop either creates separate-process exposure history (non-comparable pixels) or collides on the output name. I had to hand-author a queued PowerShell loop that invokes the executable once per state with all four angles; consolidate this into a supported matrix witness helper.

title: Native Release has no benchmark preset for frame timing
body: The required native Release frame bench needs UNDERSET_NATIVE_BENCHMARK=ON, but the Windows vixen-ninja-release preset/build.bat path exposes no benchmark preset or cache-variable pass-through. I could capture correctness goldens, but PerfCsvWriter is compiled out; consolidation should provide a queued native benchmark configure/build entry point.
